description: server.max-http-header-size moved under a different prefix. Only the YAML that binds it is affected. A second YAML uses four-space indentation and a value containing a colon, both of which defeat a matcher that assumes two-space nesting or splits on the first colon.
ground_truth_source: Hand-declared by inspection of the tree below. The harness runs ImpactStage's matcher over the tree and compares its output to this list; the fixture never states what the matcher should predict.
tuning_reason: The miss this fixture exposed drove structural YAML key resolution in the property matcher. Derived-from, therefore excluded.
